description: Hannah meets DeepMind co-founder and chief scientist Shane Legg, the man who coined the phrase ‘artificial general intelligence’, and explores how it might be built. Why does Shane think AGI is possible? When will it be realised? And what could it look like? Hannah also explores a simple theory of using trial and error to reach AGI and takes a deep dive into MuZero, an AI system which mastered complex board games from chess to Go, and is now generalising to solve a range of important tasks in th…
classificationReason: Focuses on AGI development and trial-and-error learning, including MuZero's generalization to real-world tasks.
qualityReason: Multi-interview episode with a deep technical and conceptual treatment of AGI and MuZero.
